meta.description: Canonical catalog of all FileMaker Pro script steps, organised by category. Use this for prototype/syntax lookups before fetching live docs. doc_url points to the authoritative Claris Help Centre page for each step.
meta.last_updated: 2026-07-04 (v1.9.2 content correction, second pass — full sweep of all 1,104 en/pro-help pages by topic_type confirmed 215 script-step pages; catalog now matches exactly. 215 unique steps.)
meta.update_instructions: Re-fetch https://help.claris.com/markdown/en/pro-help/script-steps-reference.md and compare category listings. Add new steps, update slugs, bump last_updated.
meta.note: Syntax uses [] for required fields/options and {} for optional. Steps marked platform list restrictions (Pro, Server, Go, WebDirect, Cloud).
meta.platform_encoding: Delta-encoded. `platform_exceptions` lists ONLY products where the step is not fully supported, keyed Pro/Go/WebDirect/Server/Cloud/DataAPI/CWP with values No or Partial. ABSENT platform_exceptions means Yes on all seven. 'No' = step is skipped and returns error 3 (Command is unavailable); 'Partial' = performed but one or more features differ (see the step's Notes).
meta.os_restriction_note: `os_restriction` is a desktop-OS limit (macOS only / Windows only) and is orthogonal to `platform_exceptions`, which is the client/host matrix.
meta.verification_method: Every entry re-derived from its live help.claris.com markdown page (## Compatibility, ## Originated in version). Roster determined structurally: set-dictionary is a real script step that Claris mislabels as topic_type: conceptual, so a topic_type sweep alone undercounts by one.

steps.name: Perform Script
steps.syntax: Perform Script [ Specified: From list ; "ScriptName" ; Parameter: value ]
steps.purpose: Runs a named script in the current or another file, optionally passing a parameter

steps.name: Perform Script On Server
steps.syntax: Perform Script on Server [ Wait for completion: On/Off ; Specified: From list ; "ScriptName" ; Parameter: value ]
steps.purpose: Runs a script on FileMaker Server (server-side scripting)

steps.name: Pause/Resume Script
steps.syntax: Pause/Resume Script [ Duration (seconds): value ]
steps.purpose: Pauses the current script for user input or a fixed duration

steps.name: Exit Script
steps.syntax: Exit Script [ Script Result: value ]
steps.purpose: Ends the current script and optionally sets a script result accessible via Get(ScriptResult)

steps.name: Halt Script
steps.syntax: Halt Script
steps.purpose: Stops all scripts in the call stack immediately

steps.name: If
steps.syntax: If [ condition ]
steps.purpose: Begins a conditional block; executes enclosed steps only when condition is true

steps.name: Else If
steps.syntax: Else If [ condition ]
steps.purpose: Additional condition branch within an If block

steps.name: Else
steps.syntax: Else
steps.purpose: Default branch executed when no If/Else If condition is true

steps.name: End If
steps.syntax: End If
steps.purpose: Closes an If block

steps.name: Loop
steps.syntax: Loop
steps.purpose: Begins a loop block that repeats until an Exit Loop If or Go to Record exits it

steps.name: Exit Loop If
steps.syntax: Exit Loop If [ condition ]
steps.purpose: Exits the enclosing Loop when condition is true

steps.name: End Loop
steps.syntax: End Loop
steps.purpose: Closes a Loop block and returns execution to the Loop step

steps.name: Allow User Abort
steps.syntax: Allow User Abort [ On/Off ]
steps.purpose: Controls whether users can stop the script with Escape/Cancel

steps.name: Set Error Capture
steps.syntax: Set Error Capture [ On/Off ]
steps.purpose: When On, suppresses FileMaker error dialogs so scripts can handle errors programmatically

steps.name: Set Variable
steps.syntax: Set Variable [ $name ; Value: expression ; Repetition: n ]
steps.purpose: Creates or sets a local ($var) or global ($$var) variable

steps.name: Install OnTimer Script
steps.syntax: Install OnTimer Script [ Interval: seconds ; Specified: From list ; "ScriptName" ; Parameter: value ]
steps.purpose: Installs a script that runs repeatedly on a timer interval

steps.name: Open Transaction
steps.syntax: Open Transaction
steps.purpose: Begins a database transaction (changes committed or rolled back as a unit)

steps.name: Commit Transaction
steps.syntax: Commit Transaction
steps.purpose: Commits an open transaction, making all changes permanent

steps.name: Revert Transaction
steps.syntax: Revert Transaction
steps.purpose: Rolls back an open transaction, discarding all changes since Open Transaction

steps.name: Set Revert Transaction on Error
steps.syntax: Set Revert Transaction on Error [On/Off]
steps.purpose: Controls whether a transaction is automatically reverted when an error occurs within an Open Transaction / Commit Transaction block. Default is On (auto-revert on error).
steps.notes: When set to Off, the script continues after an error inside a transaction block, allowing the script to handle errors itself before deciding to commit or revert. Use Get(RevertTransactionOnErrorState) to query the current setting. The setting is scoped to the current script — it does not propagate to subscripts. Reset to On before exiting scripts that set it to Off.

steps.name: Configure Local Notification
steps.syntax: Configure Local Notification [ Action: Queue/Clear ; Local Notification Name: name ; Delay Time (seconds): n ; Title: title ; Body: body ; Script: script ; Parameter: parameter ]
steps.purpose: Use this script step to display a notification alert after an optional delay.
steps.notes: FileMaker Go (iOS/iPadOS) only — queues a local notification on the device.

steps.name: Configure NFC Reading
steps.syntax: Configure NFC Reading [ Action: Read/Cancel ; Script: script ; Parameter: parameter ; Timeout (seconds): n ; Continuous reading: On/Off ]
steps.purpose: Use this script step to scan or stop scanning for NFC tags, which are programmed with a small amount of data.
steps.notes: FileMaker Go only — reads NFC tags; the specified script receives tag data as its parameter.

steps.name: Configure Region Monitor Script
steps.syntax: Configure Region Monitor Script [ Monitor: iBeacon/Geofence ; Name: name ; Script: script ; Parameter: parameter ]
steps.purpose: Use this script step to run a specified script when an iOS or iPadOS device enters or exits a region.
steps.notes: FileMaker Go only — runs a script when the device enters/exits an iBeacon or geofence region.

steps.name: Set Error Logging
steps.syntax: Set Error Logging [ On/Off ; Custom debug info: expression ]
steps.purpose: After this script step is performed, the log file is created when the first script error is caused by any script in the current file.
steps.notes: Logs script errors to ScriptErrors.log in the user's Documents folder (FileMaker Pro/Go); server-side logging locations are set by the server. Logging stays on for all scripts in the file until turned Off or the file closes.

steps.name: Set Layout Object Animation
steps.syntax: Set Layout Object Animation [ On/Off ]
steps.purpose: Enabling animations increases the time required for a script to run.

steps.name: Perform Script On Server with Callback
steps.syntax: Perform Script On Server with Callback [ Specified: From list ; "scriptName" ; Parameter: param ; Wait for completion: Off ; Callback script: "scriptName" ; Parameter: param ]
steps.purpose: The current file must be hosted on FileMaker Server or FileMaker Cloud.
steps.notes: Requires the file to be hosted on FileMaker Server or FileMaker Cloud (errors otherwise). The callback script runs in the client once the server script finishes.

steps.name: Go to Record/Request/Page
steps.syntax: Go to Record/Request/Page [ First / Last / Previous / Next / Exit after last / By Calculation: n ]

steps.name: Go to Related Record

steps.name: Go to Portal Row

steps.name: Go to Field
steps.syntax: Go to Field [ Select/perform ; Table::Field ]

steps.name: Go to Next Field
steps.syntax: Go to Next Field

steps.name: Go to Previous Field
steps.syntax: Go to Previous Field

steps.name: Enter Browse Mode
steps.syntax: Enter Browse Mode [ Pause ]

steps.name: Enter Find Mode

steps.name: Enter Preview Mode

steps.name: Scroll Window

steps.name: Select Window

steps.name: Close Popover
steps.syntax: Close Popover

steps.syntax: Go to Object [ Object Name: name ; Repetition: n ]
steps.purpose: This script step uses an object name to identify an object, so you must assign a unique object name to each object on a layout that you want to go to.
steps.notes: Targets a named layout object (set the name in the Inspector). The step formerly circulating as "Navigate to Object" does not exist — this is the real step.

steps.name: Insert Picture

steps.name: Insert Audio/Video

steps.name: Insert PDF

steps.syntax: Replace Field Contents [ No dialog ; Table::Field ; Calculated result / Serial numbers / Values from index ]

steps.name: Relookup Field Contents

steps.name: Export Field Contents
steps.syntax: Export Field Contents [ Table::Field ; output file path ; Automatically open ]
steps.purpose: Exports the contents of a container or text field to a file
steps.notes: FM 26: now supported in FileMaker Server, Data API and OData contexts.

steps.name: Cut
steps.syntax: Cut [ Select ; Table::Field ]
steps.purpose: Cuts selected content from a field to the clipboard

steps.name: Copy
steps.syntax: Copy [ Select ; Table::Field ]
steps.purpose: Copies field content or selected text to the clipboard

steps.name: Paste
steps.syntax: Paste [ Select ; No style ; Table::Field ]
steps.purpose: Pastes clipboard content into a field

steps.name: Clear

steps.purpose: Clears the selected content or entire field contents

steps.name: Undo/Redo
steps.syntax: Undo/Redo
steps.purpose: Undoes or redoes the last user action

steps.name: Perform Find/Replace
steps.syntax: Perform Find/Replace [ With dialog: On/Off ; "findText" ; "replaceText" ; Find Next/Replace & Find/Replace/Replace All ]

steps.name: Set Selection
steps.syntax: Set Selection [ Table::Field ; Start Position: n ; End Position: n ]

steps.name: Select All
steps.syntax: Select All

steps.name: Set Use System Formats
steps.syntax: Set Use System Formats [ On/Off ]

steps.name: Insert from Device
steps.syntax: Insert from Device [ table::field ; Insert from: Camera/Photo Library/Music Library/Video Camera/Microphone/Signature/Bar Code ]
steps.purpose: This script step enters content into a container field from a music library, photo library, camera, video camera, microphone, or signature; or enters content into a container field or text field from a barcode source.
steps.notes: FileMaker Go only (Bar Code also supported in FileMaker Pro via camera-less sources). Target must be a container field, or a text field for barcodes.

steps.name: Revert Record/Request

steps.syntax: Copy Record/Request

steps.name: Copy All Records/Requests

steps.purpose: Copies all records in the found set to the clipboard as tab-delimited text

steps.name: Save Records as Excel

steps.name: Save Records as Snapshot Link

steps.name: Perform Find
steps.syntax: Perform Find [ Restore ]
steps.purpose: Executes the current find request(s), updating the found set

steps.name: Perform Quick Find
steps.syntax: Perform Quick Find [ search text ]

steps.name: Modify Last Find
steps.syntax: Modify Last Find

steps.name: Show All Records
steps.syntax: Show All Records
steps.purpose: Finds all records in the current table

steps.name: Show Omitted Only
steps.syntax: Show Omitted Only
steps.purpose: Swaps found set with omitted records

steps.name: Omit Record
steps.syntax: Omit Record
steps.purpose: Removes the current record from the found set

steps.name: Omit Multiple Records
steps.syntax: Omit Multiple Records [ No dialog ; n records ]
steps.purpose: Removes n records starting from the current record from the found set

steps.purpose: Sorts the found set by the saved or specified sort order

steps.name: Sort Records by Field
steps.syntax: Sort Records by Field [ Ascending/Descending ; Table::Field ]
steps.purpose: Sorts the found set by a single specified field

steps.name: Unsort Records
steps.syntax: Unsort Records
steps.purpose: Returns records to creation order

steps.name: Go to List of Records
steps.syntax: Go to List of Records [Layout; Record IDs]
steps.purpose: Goes to a layout and returns the found set specified by a list of record IDs. Accepts a carriage-return-separated value list, a JSON array of record IDs as strings or numbers, or a JSON array of objects with recordId keys.
steps.notes: Use with GetRecordIDsFromFoundSet to preserve and restore found sets across script jumps or file switches. Layout option: specify a layout name (defaults to current layout). The Record IDs parameter accepts: (1) value list — one ID per line, (2) JSONArray of number or string IDs, (3) JSONArray of objects with 'recordId' key. Records not found are silently skipped. If none of the IDs match, the found set is empty. Not supported in FileMaker WebDirect.

steps.name: Find Matching Records
steps.syntax: Find Matching Records [ Replace/Constrain/Extend ; table::field ]
steps.purpose: Finds records based on the context of a specified field, letting you create scripts that behave similarly to using the shortcut menu in Table View.

steps.name: Move/Resize Window

steps.name: Arrange All Windows

steps.name: Freeze Window

steps.name: Refresh Window

steps.name: Refresh Object

steps.purpose: Refreshes a named layout object without refreshing the whole window

steps.name: Set Window Title

steps.name: Show/Hide Menubar

steps.name: Show/Hide Toolbars

steps.purpose: Shows, hides, or toggles the status toolbar (FileMaker Pro) or toolbar (FileMaker Go), optionally locking its state.

steps.name: View As

steps.name: Close File

steps.name: Convert File

steps.name: Open File

steps.name: Save Records as JSONL
steps.purpose: Saves records to a specified JSONL file; each line is a JSON object representing a record. Used to output record data for fine-tuning a model.
steps.syntax: Save Records as JSONL [ No dialog ; File: <path> ; Fields: <field list> ]
steps.notes: Format for fine-tuning On: requires three explicit prompts — System Prompt (optional), User Prompt, Assistant Prompt. Format for fine-tuning Off: Completion Field required; all other fields become user prompt content. Container fields are skipped (Off mode) or exported as filename string (On mode). Compatibility: not supported on FileMaker Go or WebDirect.

steps.syntax: Save a Copy as [ No dialog ; output file ; Type: copy/compacted/self-contained ]

steps.name: Set Multi-User

steps.name: Close Data File
steps.syntax: Close Data File [ File ID: fileID ]

steps.name: Create Data File

steps.syntax: Delete File [ "filePath" ]

steps.purpose: Opens a URL in the default web browser, or a filemaker:// URL to open a file

steps.name: Open Edit Saved Finds
steps.syntax: Open Edit Saved Finds
steps.purpose: Use this script step to open the Edit Saved Finds dialog box for users if you have restricted their access to FileMaker Pro menus.

steps.name: Open Favorites

steps.purpose: This script step is the same as choosing File menu > Favorites > Show Favorites.

steps.name: Open Find/Replace
steps.syntax: Open Find/Replace
steps.purpose: This script step is the same as choosing Edit menu > Find/Replace > Find/Replace.

steps.name: Open Hosts
steps.syntax: Open Hosts
steps.purpose: The Hosts dialog box allows you to select and open a shared FileMaker Pro file over a network connection.

steps.name: Open Manage Containers
steps.syntax: Open Manage Containers
steps.purpose: This script step opens the Manage Containers dialog box, where the user can manage thumbnail settings and external locations for container content.

steps.name: Open Manage Layouts

steps.name: Open Manage Themes
steps.syntax: Open Manage Themes

steps.name: Open Script Workspace
steps.syntax: Open Script Workspace
steps.purpose: This script step is the same as choosing Scripts menu > Script Workspace, or File menu > Manage > Scripts.

steps.name: Open Upload To Host

steps.purpose: This script step is the same as choosing File menu > Sharing > Upload to Host.

steps.name: Show Custom Dialog
steps.syntax: Show Custom Dialog [ Title: text ; Message: text ; Buttons ; Input fields ]
steps.purpose: Displays a custom dialog with title, message, up to 3 buttons, and up to 3 input fields

steps.name: Beep
steps.syntax: Beep
steps.purpose: Plays the system alert sound

steps.name: Speak (macOS)
steps.syntax: Speak [ text ; Wait for speech completion ; Voice: name ]
steps.purpose: Speaks text using the system text-to-speech engine (macOS only)

steps.name: # (Comment)
steps.syntax: Comment [ text ]
steps.purpose: Non-executing annotation step for documenting scripts

steps.name: Flush Cache to Disk
steps.syntax: Flush Cache to Disk
steps.purpose: Forces the FileMaker cache to be written to disk immediately

steps.name: Exit Application
steps.syntax: Exit Application
steps.purpose: Closes all files and quits FileMaker Pro

steps.name: Install Menu Set
steps.syntax: Install Menu Set [ Specify: From list ; "MenuSetName" / Standard FileMaker Menus ]
steps.purpose: Installs a custom menu set for the current window

steps.name: Install Plug-In File
steps.syntax: Install Plug-In File [ Table::ContainerField ]
steps.purpose: Installs a plug-in from a container field

steps.name: Send DDE Execute (Windows)
steps.syntax: Send DDE Execute [ Service Name: text ; Topic: text ; Commands: text ]
steps.purpose: Sends a DDE command to another application (Windows only)

steps.name: Send Event
steps.syntax: Send Event [ Send: an application / a document ; Application: name ; Calculation: text ]
steps.purpose: Sends an Apple Event to another application (macOS only)

steps.name: Trigger Claris Connect Flow
steps.purpose: Trigger a Claris Connect flow from a FileMaker script.
steps.syntax: Trigger Claris Connect Flow [ URL: url ; JSON Data: json ; AppID:APIKey for Webhooks: text ; Target: field/variable ; Flow: flow ]
steps.notes: Passes JSON parameters to a Claris Connect flow and optionally captures the response. Requires Claris Connect configured and the file hosted on FileMaker Server. Not available in FileMaker Go or WebDirect.

steps.name: Set Session Identifier
steps.purpose: Assign a custom identifier string to the current session for use with Get(SessionIdentifier).
steps.syntax: Set Session Identifier [ Value: <text> ]
steps.notes: Does not change Get(UserName). Only meaningful for hosted files — used to tag sessions for logging or tracking. Pairs with Get(SessionIdentifier) to retrieve the value in calculations or scripts.

steps.name: Flush Web Viewer Cookies
steps.syntax: Flush Web Viewer Cookies
steps.purpose: Immediately clears all web viewer cookies across all open files in the current client
steps.notes: Clears cookies from all web viewer objects in all open files for the current client. Takes effect immediately without requiring a web viewer reload. Useful for session logout workflows or testing authenticated web content.

steps.name: Allow Formatting Bar
steps.syntax: Allow Formatting Bar [ On/Off ]
steps.purpose: This script step works in all modes except Layout mode.

steps.name: Enable Touch Keyboard
steps.syntax: Enable Touch Keyboard [ On/Off ]
steps.purpose: Use this script to enable or disable the touch keyboard in FileMaker Go or Windows.
steps.notes: Windows and FileMaker Go — controls the on-screen touch keyboard.

steps.name: Perform AppleScript (macOS)
steps.syntax: Perform AppleScript [ Calculated AppleScript / "script text" ]
steps.purpose: You can create a calculation to generate the AppleScript commands to be sent, or you can type the commands directly into the Native AppleScript text area.
steps.notes: macOS only. Skipped (error 3) on Windows, FileMaker Go, and WebDirect.

steps.name: Perform JavaScript in Web Viewer
steps.syntax: Perform JavaScript in Web Viewer [ Object Name: name ; Function Name: functionName ; Parameters: p1, p2, … ]
steps.purpose: This script step performs a function in JavaScript code that is loaded by a webpage in a web viewer then waits for the JavaScript function to finish.
steps.notes: Function name is case sensitive. Pair with the JavaScript FileMaker.PerformScript() API for two-way calls.

steps.name: Refresh Portal
steps.syntax: Refresh Portal [ Object Name: name ]
steps.purpose: Refresh Portal updates the join relationship and contents of a portal that displays related records.

steps.name: Save a Copy as Add-on Package
steps.syntax: Save a Copy as Add-on Package [ "packageName" ; Replace existing package: On/Off ]
steps.purpose: This script step creates an add-on package from an open FileMaker Pro file.

steps.name: Send Mail
steps.syntax: Send Mail [ Send via E-mail Client/SMTP Server/OAuth 2.0 ; With dialog: On/Off ; To: to ; Cc: cc ; Bcc: bcc ; Subject: subject ; Message: message ; Attach file: "path" ]
steps.purpose: Send Mail sends an intranet or internet email through an email application, via SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol), or via OAuth 2.0.
steps.notes: E-mail Client mode is not supported server-side or in WebDirect — use SMTP Server or OAuth 2.0 there.

steps.name: Set Web Viewer
steps.syntax: Set Web Viewer [ Object Name: name ; Action: Reset/Reload/Go Forward/Go Back/Go to URL ; URL: url ]
steps.purpose: This script step works only for named web viewer objects.

steps.name: AVPlayer Play
steps.syntax: AVPlayer Play [ table::field / Object Name: name / URL: url ]
steps.purpose: Use this script to play media files from container fields, layout objects, or URLs in FileMaker Go.
steps.notes: FileMaker Go only — plays audio, video, or image media from a container field, layout object, or URL.

steps.name: AVPlayer Set Options
steps.syntax: AVPlayer Set Options [ Position: seconds ; Volume: level ; Zoom: setting ; Presentation: setting ]
steps.purpose: Changes options (position, volume, zoom, presentation) for media currently playing or paused in FileMaker Go.
steps.notes: FileMaker Go only — changes settings of media that is playing or paused.

steps.name: AVPlayer Set Playback State
steps.syntax: AVPlayer Set Playback State [ Playing/Paused/Stopped ]
steps.purpose: Use this script step to pause, resume, or stop playing a media file that is playing or is paused.
steps.notes: FileMaker Go only.

steps.name: Dial Phone
steps.syntax: Dial Phone [ With dialog: On/Off ; "phoneNumber" ]
steps.purpose: You can enter a phone number or specify a calculation to create a phone number.
steps.notes: FileMaker Go (iOS) only — letters in the number are translated to digits.

steps.name: Execute FileMaker Data API
steps.syntax: Execute FileMaker Data API [ Select entire contents ; Target: field/variable ; "json request" ]
steps.purpose: The FileMaker Data API is a REST API available as a web service for FileMaker Server and FileMaker Cloud.
steps.notes: Runs a Data API request against the current file directly — no network call or Data API session required. Request and response are JSON.

steps.name: Execute SQL
steps.syntax: Execute SQL [ With dialog: On/Off ; ODBC data source ; Calculated SQL text ]
steps.purpose: You can use this script step to manage data in an ODBC data source through an ODBC SQL interface.
steps.notes: Legacy ODBC step — sends SQL to an external ODBC data source. Distinct from the ExecuteSQL calculation function, which queries FileMaker tables.

steps.name: Get Folder Path
steps.syntax: Get Folder Path [ Allow Folder Creation ; Target: $folderPath ]
steps.purpose: This script step prompts the user to select a folder, then it sets a variable to the fully qualified path of the selected folder.
steps.notes: Formerly named "Get Directory" — the doc slug is still get-directory. Prompts the user to select a folder and stores the full path in a variable.

steps.name: Create PDF
steps.syntax: Create PDF
steps.purpose: Creates a new empty PDF in memory; begins the scripted PDF workflow
steps.notes: Starts the PDF Files workflow. Use Append PDF or Save Records as PDF (with Save to: open PDF option) to add pages, then Close PDF to save to a file path, container, or variable. Only one PDF can be open at a time.

steps.name: Open PDF
steps.syntax: Open PDF [ File Path: <path or variable> ]
steps.purpose: Opens an existing PDF for modification within the scripted PDF workflow
steps.notes: Alternative to Create PDF when modifying an existing document. Accepts a file path or a container field/variable containing a PDF. Use Append PDF or Save Records as PDF (with Save to: open PDF) to add pages, then Close PDF to save.

steps.name: Append PDF
steps.syntax: Append PDF [ Source: <file path, container, or variable> ]
steps.purpose: Appends pages from an existing PDF to the currently open PDF in memory
steps.notes: Requires an open PDF (via Create PDF or Open PDF). Source can be a file path, container field, or variable. Pages are appended in document order. Close PDF when finished to persist the result.

steps.name: Save Records as PDF
steps.syntax: Save Records as PDF [ No dialog ; Append ; Save to: File / Container / Variable / Open PDF ; Output file ; Current record / Records being browsed / Blank record ]
steps.purpose: Saves records or a blank layout to a PDF; in FM 26 moved to PDF Files category and gained Save to option (file path, container, variable, or append to an open PDF)
steps.notes: FM 26: moved from Files category to PDF Files. New Save to option: File (original behaviour), Container field, Variable, or Open PDF (appends layout output to the currently open scripted PDF). Fetch live docs for the full Save to option matrix.

steps.name: Close PDF
steps.syntax: Close PDF [ Save to: File Path / Container / Variable ; Output: <field or path> ]
steps.purpose: Closes the open PDF and saves it to a file path, container field, or variable
steps.notes: Ends the scripted PDF workflow and persists the result. Must follow Create PDF or Open PDF. If Close PDF is not called before a script ends, the in-memory PDF is discarded (same as Cancel PDF). Fetch live docs for output option detail.

steps.name: Cancel PDF
steps.syntax: Cancel PDF
steps.purpose: Closes the open PDF without saving, discarding all changes
steps.notes: Discards the in-memory PDF without saving. Use in error-handling branches to clean up when the PDF workflow cannot complete. No output is produced.

steps.name: Print PDF
steps.syntax: Print PDF [ No dialog ; Source: <file path, container, or variable> ]
steps.purpose: Prints a PDF from a file path, container field, or variable without opening it for editing
steps.notes: Standalone print step — does not require Create PDF or Open PDF. Source can be a file path, a container field holding a PDF, or a variable. The No dialog option suppresses the print dialog.

steps.name: Print Setup
steps.syntax: Print Setup [ No dialog ; Restore ]
steps.purpose: Configures page/print settings

steps.name: Print
steps.syntax: Print [ No dialog ; Restore ; Current record / Records being browsed / Blank record showing fields ]
steps.purpose: Prints the current found set or record

steps.name: Configure AI Account
steps.syntax: Configure AI Account [ Account Name: name ; Model Provider: OpenAI/Anthropic/Custom ; API key: key ; Endpoint: url ]
steps.purpose: Configures a named AI account for use with AI functions and script steps

steps.name: Configure Machine Learning Model
steps.syntax: Configure Machine Learning Model [ Operation: Vision/Regression ; Name: name ; From: field ]
steps.purpose: Loads a Core ML model for use with ComputeModel or PredictFromModel (macOS/iOS only)

steps.name: Configure Prompt Template
steps.purpose: Set up a named prompt template to use in other AI script steps.
steps.syntax: Configure Prompt Template [ Account Name: <name> ; Template Name: <name> ; Template: <text> ]
steps.notes: Template Types: SQL Query, Find Request, RAG Prompt. Template constants: :schema: (DDL schema), :question: (user prompt), :context: (RAG context), :sql_query: (generated SQL), :sql_results: (query results), :date_format: (date format string). Template names are case-sensitive. Templates are session-scoped and cleared on file close.

steps.name: Configure RAG Account
steps.syntax: Configure RAG Account [ Account Name: name ; API key: key ; Endpoint: url ]
steps.purpose: Configure a named RAG account connecting to a FileMaker Server AI Model Server knowledge store.
steps.notes: Endpoint URL must end with /. API Key obtained from FileMaker Server Admin Console. Verify SSL Certificates option behaves the same as Configure AI Account. Account is cleared on file close (session-scoped).

steps.name: Configure Regression Model
steps.syntax: Configure Regression Model [ Action: Train/Load/Unload ; Model Name: name ; ... ]
steps.purpose: Trains or loads a regression model for use with PredictFromModel
steps.notes: Actions: Train (uses Random Forest algorithm), Save, Load, Unload. Train parameters: numTrees (default 10), maxDepth (10), minSamplesSplit (2), numFeatures (-1 = all), maxFeatures (1 = sqrt of features). Models remain in memory until Unload action or session end. Pairs with PredictFromModel function.

steps.name: Fine-Tune Model
steps.purpose: Fine-tune a model using a training data set.
steps.syntax: Fine-Tune Model [ Account Name: name ; Base Model: model ; Training Data: Table/File ; Response Target: field/variable ; Fine-Tune Parameters: JSON ]
steps.notes: Training data source: Table or JSONL File. Uses LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) technique. ONLY supported on OpenAI or AI Model Server running on Apple silicon Mac — not available for other providers or Linux/Windows hosts. Fine-tune parameters: max_steps (1000), learning_rate (2e-4), lora_layers (4), batch_size (1), fine_tuned_model_name. AI Model Server prefixes model name with fm-mlx- (e.g. my-model → fm-mlx-my-model). Response Target returns job JSON with status 'queued' — training is asynchronous; monitor via Admin Console. Pairs with Save Records as JSONL for training data preparation.

steps.name: Generate Response from Model
steps.purpose: Facilitate multistep agentic interaction between your custom app and AI models, supporting built-in and custom function tool calls.
steps.syntax: Generate Response from Model [ Account Name: name ; Model: model ; User Prompt: text ; Agentic mode: On/Off ; Response: field/variable ; Instructions: text ; Messages: field/variable ]
steps.notes: Agentic mode On: enables full multi-round tool execution. Agentic mode Off: stops after first tool call and returns tool call JSON (useful for debugging). Built-in tool definitions: execute_sql (generates and runs SQL; append DDL schema to parameter description), retrieve_image (fetches image from container field via SQL ROWID). Custom function tools: name must exactly match FileMaker custom function name; parameters must be in same order and count, always typed as string. Stream On: incremental delivery; target field must be on current layout. Messages/Save Message History To/Message History Count: manage multi-turn conversation history. Temperature range varies by model provider. Error: 'No tool call exists for the prompt' when model doesn't call a tool. Error: 'Function not found' when custom function is missing. Full platform compatibility. FM 26 adds an 'Include tool calls and tool results' option. Google Gemini is supported as a text-generation provider. Fetch live — AI options change fast.

steps.name: Insert Embedding
steps.syntax: Insert Embedding [ Account Name: name ; Embedding Model: model ; Input: expression ; Parameters: JSON ; Target: field/variable ]
steps.purpose: Generates an embedding vector and stores it in a container field

steps.name: Insert Embedding in Found Set
steps.purpose: Insert embedding vectors for all records in the current found set.
steps.syntax: Insert Embedding in Found Set [ Account Name: <name> ; Embedding Model: <model> ; Input: <field> ; Target: <field> ]
steps.notes: Parameters JSON keys: MaxRecPerCall (default 20, max 500), MaxRetryPerWorker (5), MaxWaitPerRetry (60000 ms, OpenAI only), TruncateTokenLimit (8185), TruncateEnabled (1), RetryOnError (0). RetryOnError overrides the Continue on error option.

steps.name: Perform Find by Natural Language
steps.purpose: Get a found set by sending a natural language prompt and layout fields to a model.
steps.syntax: Perform Find by Natural Language [ Account Name: <name> ; Model: <model> ; Prompt: <text> ; Response Target: <field/variable> ]
steps.notes: Get options: Found Set (updates current found set), Found Set as JSON (Data API format), Find Request as JSON (debug — inspect the find criteria without performing the find). Uses GetFieldsOnLayout to determine which fields are sent to the model. Supports context_prompt parameter key for date/time context. Cannot perform finds requiring aggregate functions (e.g. find the record with the highest value in a field). Returns error 401 when no records match.

steps.name: Perform RAG Action
steps.purpose: Add or remove data in a RAG knowledge space, or send a prompt to a RAG space for context-aware AI responses.
steps.syntax: Perform RAG Action [ RAG Account Name: <name> ; AI Account Name: <name> ; Action: Add Data / Send Prompt / Remove Data ; Input: <field/file/container/variable> ; Prompt Template Name: <name> ; Response Target: <field/variable> ]
steps.notes: Add Data actions: From Text, From File, From File (Async), From Container, From Container (Async). Async is recommended for large PDFs. WebDirect ignores Input File path and opens Insert dialog instead. Send Prompt: uses both a RAG Account and an AI Account; supports context_prompt parameter key; optional Prompt Template Name. Remove Data: pass JSON with id array; irreversible — warn users to retain originals. PDF with encryption cannot be added. Adding a PDF with the same filename removes the existing entry.

steps.name: Perform SQL Query by Natural Language
steps.purpose: Send a natural language prompt and database schema to a model, which generates and runs SQL queries to return a result.
steps.syntax: Perform SQL Query by Natural Language [ Account Name: <name> ; Model: <model> ; Prompt: <text> ; Data Tables: <tables> ; Action: Query ; Response Target: <field/variable> ]
steps.notes: Action options: Query (run SQL and return data), Query for Data Only (suppress column headers), Get SQL (return all generated SQL without executing), Get First SQL Only (first SQL only — saves tokens), Get DDL (returns schema only, no model call). Data Tables: From list (select in dialog), By name (field/variable), By DDL (custom DDL for fine-grained schema control). Options: From list or By JSON data (dynamic configuration). Field comments in Manage Database dialog are sent to the model as schema context. Compatibility partial for Server, Cloud, Data API, Custom Web Publishing — Perform JavaScript in Web Viewer not supported server-side.

steps.name: Perform Semantic Find
steps.syntax: Perform Semantic Find [ Query by: Natural language/Vector data/Image ; Record set: All records/Current found set ; Target field: field ; Return count: n ; Cosine similarity condition ; Cosine similarity value ; Parameters: JSON ; Save result ]
steps.purpose: Finds the top K records most semantically similar to a query embedding vector
steps.notes: Query by: Embedding (vector) or Image (pass a container field or variable containing an image — the step generates the query embedding internally). Save result option: set a variable to receive a JSON array of objects with recordID and cosineSimilarity scores for each matched record. Normalised embedding vectors required for accurate results. Both query and stored embeddings must have identical dimensions.

steps.name: Set AI Call Logging
steps.purpose: Control logging of AI calls made from the current file.
steps.syntax: Set AI Call Logging [ On/Off ; Mode: Standard/Verbose ; Truncate Messages: On/Off ]
steps.notes: Verbose mode: logs embedding vectors, token counts, semantic find return count, and cosine similarity scores. Truncate Messages: shortens verbose output for large embedding vectors. Standard mode logs prompts and responses without embedding detail.

steps.name: Insert Image Caption
steps.syntax: Insert Image Caption [ Account Name: name ; Model: model ; Input: expression ; Target: field/variable ]
steps.purpose: Sends an image to a captioning AI model and inserts the returned caption into a target field or variable
steps.notes: Requires a configured AI account. Image source can be a container field or a variable containing image data. Caption is inserted into the target field or variable. Use Insert Image Captions in Found Set for batch processing.

steps.name: Insert Image Captions in Found Set
steps.syntax: Insert Image Captions in Found Set [ Account Name: name ; Model: model ; Source Field: field ; Target Field: field ; Replace target contents ; Continue on error ; Parameters: JSON ]
steps.purpose: Runs Insert Image Caption for every record in the current found set in sequence
steps.notes: Batch version of Insert Image Caption. Processes every record in the found set sequentially. Requires a configured AI account. Both the image source and target must be fields (not variables) since the step iterates records.

steps.name: Configure Persistent Data
steps.syntax: Configure Persistent Data [ Name: <name> ; Instance ID: <id> ; Value: <value> ]
steps.purpose: Sets or deletes an entry in the persistent data store; store survives session end and file close
steps.notes: Entries are keyed by a name and an instance ID, allowing multiple values under the same name. Delete an entry by passing empty or null as the Value. Use ListPersistentDataIDs() to enumerate instance IDs before iterating. Use GetPersistentData() to retrieve values. Fetch live docs for scope and platform restrictions.
